seo.title: No-code workflow builder for WhatsApp and Shopify | Steps AI
seo.description: Recover carts, confirm COD orders, send updates and alert your team with ready-made workflows, or build your own without code.

hero.title: Automate the follow-ups your team keeps forgetting.
hero.body: Start from a ready-made template, such as cart recovery or COD confirmation, or build your own from menus. Workflows run on events from your store, your chats and your forms.
hero.reassurance: Ready-made templates. Menus, not code. Drafts until you switch them on.

steps.title: How a workflow comes together.
steps.intro: “You are not writing code, you are choosing from menus.”

items.title: Pick a template or start fresh
items.body: Templates cover cart recovery, order updates, review requests, win-back and team alerts.

items.title: Choose the trigger
items.body: Start on a message, a schedule, a form submission, a webhook or an event from a connected app such as Shopify.

items.title: Add the steps
items.body: Wait, check a condition, send a WhatsApp or website message, send an email or call another tool.

items.title: Switch it on and watch the runs
items.body: Workflows stay as drafts until you activate them. Run history shows what happened.

features.title: What you can automate.
features.intro: Recovery, lifecycle messages and internal alerts.

items.title: Recover carts and checkouts
items.body: Follow up on the website widget, by email or on WhatsApp when shoppers leave without paying.

items.title: Confirm cash on delivery orders
items.body: Ask COD customers to confirm, and send a payment link to switch to prepaid.

items.title: Send order and shipping updates
items.body: Confirm orders, share shipping updates and ask for a review after delivery.

items.title: Win back customers
items.body: Reach customers who cancelled or have gone quiet, with a discount code you create.

items.title: Alert your team
items.body: Notify your team about high-value orders and refunds.

items.title: Branch on conditions
items.body: Compare values from earlier steps and take different paths.

items.title: Choose what happens on errors
items.body: Fail, skip or retry each step.

items.title: Collect details with forms
items.body: Link a public form to a workflow and act on each submission.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: Most ready-made templates are built for Shopify stores.
WhatsApp messages sent by a workflow use templates approved by Meta.

items.a: No. Templates are the easiest start, and every step is chosen from menus. Webhooks and HTTP requests are there if your team wants them.

items.q: Does a workflow run as soon as I save it?
items.a: No. Workflows save as drafts and only run once you switch them on.

items.q: Can I see what a workflow did?
items.a: Yes. Run history shows each run, its progress and any errors.
